background.description: Expected background b (same units as n).

background_uncertainty.description: Gaussian standard uncertainty on b (0 = background exactly known).

signal_expected.description: Expected signal events s at signal strength mu = 1.

signal_max.description: Upper edge of the signal-events grid (default n + 5 sqrt(n + b) + 10, at least 10).

signal_step.description: Grid step (default max(0.01, signal_max / 2000)); signal_max / signal_step must not exceed 20000.
